biggest_catch: The referral coupon must be picked up at the MCU office and presented at the time the friend opens their Primary Savings Account - it cannot be applied later - and the new member must live, work, study, or worship in Fairfield County, CT.
catches: Existing member earns $25 for each new member they refer who opens a Primary Savings Account with a referral coupon.
Coupon must be picked up at the MCU office, filled out, and presented by the new member at account opening; cannot be applied later.
New member must live, work, study, or worship in Fairfield County, CT and must be opening their first Primary Savings Account.

Bonuses credited to both parties upon account opening if accounts are in good standing (no negative balances or loan delinquencies); employees, volunteers, and their immediate family members are not eligible.
Promotion valid through December 31, 2026, but may be modified or withdrawn at any time; no referral cap stated.
